name: feature-velocity

frames.best_why: The violet hover wash is at its strongest and all three cards plus the headline stay legible.

tagline: Three dark feature cards bloom with colour as the cursor passes.
summary: A black feature grid under an oversized uppercase headline: three cards with icon tiles and short labels, each lighting up with its own colour wash when hovered.
appearance: A black section with a faint diagonal pinstripe texture fading downward. An enormous white uppercase headline sits left of a tiny grey mono paragraph, above three dark rounded cards each with a small pale icon tile, a faint label and a bold uppercase title.
behaviour: Hovering a card washes it with a soft diagonal colour tint, violet for the first, green for the second, and dims its outline toward black. The tint fades out again when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: 'High Velocity Distribution.' headline with cards Neural Link, Data Core and Fluid UI.
search_phrases: dark feature cards with hover glow
card that lights up on hover
mono label above bold white title
use_when: A dark technical product page needs three headline capabilities that react to the pointer.
avoid_when: Cards are fixed in the source, and the tiny grey labels fail contrast on dark screens.
customise: Card titles, labels, icons and tint colours are inline in the map; spacing and the stripe backdrop are section classes.
weight_why: Three static cards with a CSS opacity fade on hover.

a11y.note: The colour reveal exists only on hover, so touch users never see it, and the icons are unlabelled.

issues: The hover colour wash never appears on touch screens.
Tiny grey label and side-note text is near-invisible against black.
polish_why: Strong brutalist type and a tidy three-up grid; faint labels and low contrast are the weak spots.
